Daily Quiz.question: ১) A simple sentence refers -
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Easy to understand.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) An one claused sentence.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Small sentence.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Combination of more than one clause.
Daily Quiz.exp:
একটি মাত্র subject এবং একটি মাত্র finite নিয়ে গঠিত sentence কে simple sentence বলে।
যেমন - They play cricket.

Daily Quiz.question: ২) Which of the following sentences is a compound sentence?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Without working hard, you cannot succeed.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) He not only ate rice but also took tea.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) How he does the work is a mystery.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) you will do If I do.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Compound sentence-এ একের অধিক principal clause থাকে যাদেরকে co-ordinate clause বলা হয়।
অর্থাৎ Compound sentence এ দুই বা ততোধিক principal clause বা co-ordinate clause থাকে।

এছাড়া Compound sentence এ সাধারণত and, or, but, yet, so, therefore, otherwise, else, both --- and , either --- or , neither — nor, not only --- but also ইত্যাদি co-ordinating conjunction দ্বারা দুইটি principal clause যুক্ত থাকে।

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) The water being very hot, I could not drink it. This is a/an -
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) complex sentence
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) compound sentence
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) simple sentence
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) imperative sentence
Daily Quiz.exp:
Simple sentence is a sentence consisting of only one clause, with a single subject and predicate.

The water being very hot - এর মধ্যে কোন Finite Verb নেই, তাই পুরো বাক্যের মধ্যে Clause আছে একটি। সুতরাং এটি Simple Sentence.

Source: Oxford Dictionary

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Make haste, else you will miss the train. The following sentence is a -
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Simple Sentence
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Complex Sentence
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Compound Sentence
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Multiple Sentence
Daily Quiz.exp:
Compound sentence-এ একের অধিক principal clause থাকে যাদেরকে co-ordinate clause বলা হয়।
অর্থাৎ Compound sentence এ দুই বা ততোধিক principal clause বা co-ordinate clause থাকে।

এছাড়া Compound sentence এ সাধারণত and, or, but, yet, so, therefore, otherwise, else, both --- and , either --- or , neither — nor, not only --- but also ইত্যাদি co-ordinating conjunction দ্বারা দুইটি principal clause যুক্ত থাকে।

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Our present home suits us. (Make it complex)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The home which we live suits us at present.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) The home is suitable in where we live now.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) The home in which we live at present suits us.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) The home in which we live is suitable.
Daily Quiz.exp: Simple sentence কে complex sentence এ রূপান্তরিত করতে হলে প্রথমে দুটি clause এ পরিণত করতে হয় এবং উপযুক্ত relative clause, pronoun, preposition বা adverb বসাতে হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) “My pen has been stolen”. (Make it active)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He has stoled my pen.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Someone has stoled my pen.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Somebody have stolen my pen.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Someone has stolen my pen.
Daily Quiz.exp:
বাক্যে ক্রিয়ার কর্তা দেয়া না থাকলে passive থেকে active করার সময় একটি সুবিধাজনক কর্তা যেমন - someone, somebody, people, the authority ইত্যাদি ধরে নিতে হবে।
Steal এর past participle form - stolen.
Somebody এর সাথে has ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) All of his friends laughed at him. (Make it passive)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He had laughed by all of his friends.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) He was laughed by all of his friends.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) He was laughed at by all of his friends.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) He laughed at all of his friends.
Daily Quiz.exp:
বাক্যে verb টি যদি phrasal verb হয় তাহলে তার সাথে সংযুক্ত preposition সব সময় verb এর সাথে সাথে থাকবে।
আর passive sentence টি past indefinite থাকায় active করার সময় was ব্যবহৃত হবে।

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) They made him show them all papers. (Make it passive)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He was made by them to show them all papers.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) He was made to show them all papers.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) He was made to show them all papers to them.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) All papers was made to be show them.
Daily Quiz.exp: Active voice এ যদি need, bid, dare, make, hear, see, help, know ইত্যাদি verb গুলো থাকে তাহলে passive করার সময় এদের পরে “to” বসে।

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) “You are requested not to smoke”. (Make it active)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Do not smoke.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Do not smoking.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Please do not smoking.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Please do not smoke.
Daily Quiz.exp: Passive voice এ “You are requested to” থাকলে active voice এ please/ kindlily ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং Imperative sentence হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) Shimul is one of the best boys in the class. (Make it positive)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) No other boy is better than Shimul in the class.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Very few boys in the class is as good as Shimul.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Very few boy in the class are as good as Shimul.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Very few boys in the class are as good as Shimul.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Superlative degree তে one of the + superlative + noun (plural) থাকলে positive করার সময়
Very few --- as ... as/ so ... as
এই structure follow করা হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) Choose the correct sentence -
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) I thought that the prettiest of all was the last one.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Very few man in the world were so bad as he.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) The more you practice speaking, you will do it better.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) No animal is so big than the blue whale.
Daily Quiz.exp:
The correct sentences are -
- Very few men in the world were so bad as he.
- The more you practice speaking, the better you will do it.
- No animal is so big as the blue whale.

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) The Disney park in England is ____ Canada.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The largest than the ones in
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Larger than the one
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) The largest one in
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Larger than the ones in
Daily Quiz.exp:
দুটির মধ্যে compare করার জন্য comparative degree ব্যবহৃত হয়।
সঠিক বাক্যটি হলো - The Disney park in England is larger than the ones in Canada.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) Which of the following is not a simple sentence?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The machine is working beyond our expectations.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Despite his poverty, he is happy.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) I do not know what his father’s name is.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) None of these
Daily Quiz.exp:
১ম ও ২য় বাক্যে একটি subject ও একটি finite verb থাকায় বাক্য দুটি simple sentence.
৩য় বাক্যে একাধিক subject ও finite verb আছে এবং what দ্বারা দুটি clause যুক্ত হয়েছে তাই এটি complex sentence.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) Though he walked fast, he missed the bus. (Make it compound)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He walked fast and missed the bus.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Inspite of this walking fast, he missed the bus.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) He walked fast but missed the bus.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) But for his walking fast, he missed the bus.
Daily Quiz.exp: Complex sentence এ though, although ইত্যাদি থাকলে compound sentence এ রূপান্তর করার সময় but ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) Which of the following is not a complex sentence?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The sun having set, we went home.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) This is the act that a wise man does.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) If it rains, the match will be postponed.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) He has lost the book, which I gave him.
Daily Quiz.exp:
একটি principal clause এবং এক বা একাধিক sub-ordinate নিয়ে গঠিত sentence কে complex sentence বলে।
প্রথম বাক্যটিতে একটি মাত্র finite verb রয়েছে তাই এটি simple sentence.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) She saw the boy and fell in love immediately. (Make it complex)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Seeing the boy, she fell in love quickly.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Seeing the boy, immediately she fell in love with him.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) She fell in love immediately after seeing the boy.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) As soon as she saw the boy, she fell in love with him.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Complex sentence এ দুটি clause থাকে যাদের মধ্যে একটি principal clause এবং অন্যটি subordinate clause.
Compound sentence এ immediately / at that very moment থাকলে complex sentence এ as soon as বসে।
সুতরাং প্রদত্ত বাক্যটির complex হলো - As soon as she saw the boy, she fell in love with him.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) If you speak the truth, I will let him go. (Make it compound)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Speaking the truth and I will let him go.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) He speak the truth and I leave him.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Speak the truth but I will let him go.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Speak the truth and I will let him go.
Daily Quiz.exp:
এ ধরনের Complex sentence কে compound এ রূপান্তরিত করতে হলে if, which ইত্যাদি তুলে দিয়ে and, but, yet ইত্যাদি conjunction যুক্ত করতে হয় এবং এতে একাধিক clause থাকে।
তাই সঠিক expression - Speak the truth and I will let him go.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) The weather was very cold and nobody was outside the home. (Make it complex)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The weather being very cold, nobody was outside the home.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) As the weather was very cold, nobody was outside the home.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) The weather was very cold, nobody was outside the home.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) As he weather being very cold, nobody was outside the home.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Complex বাক্যে দুটি clause থাকে যাদের মধ্যে একটি principal clause এবং আর একটি subordinate clause.
Subordinate clause টি if, though, as, since ইত্যাদি দ্বারা যুক্ত থাকে।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Della had an ardent desire to give her husband a worthy gift. (Make it complex)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Della had an ardent desire so that she could give her husband a worthy gift.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Della had an ardent desire and it was to give her husband a worthy gift.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Della had an ardent desire, it was to give her husband a worthy gift.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Della having an ardent desire, it was to give her husband a worthy gift.
Daily Quiz.exp: Simple sentence কে complex sentence এ রূপান্তরিত করতে হলে প্রথমে দুটি clause এ পরিণত করতে হয় এবং উপযুক্ত relative clause, pronoun, preposition বা adverb বসাতে হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) Which one is a complex sentence?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) I work more in order to earn more money.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) I work more so that I can earn more money.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) I work more but I can't earn more money.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) I work more and I can earn more money.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Simple sentence- পরবর্তী অংশটি in order to দ্বারা যুক্ত থাকে।
কিন্তু Complex Sentence-এর ক্ষেত্রে in order that / so that + sub + may/might দ্বারা পরবর্তী অংশ গঠিত হয়।
সুতরাং, I work more so that I can earn more money হলো একটি Complex Sentence.
